batch.topic: A restaurant offers the salad before the main dish but only if the customer wants separate courses; offering is not automatic action.
A jar contains a spice blend whose label names cumin and coriander; distinguish a listed ingredient from a suggested garnish.
A baker weighs flour before sifting, so the stated amount refers to unsifted flour; do not reverse that order.
A cook keeps the liquid from stewed fruit separate from the fruit until serving; do not turn stewing into frying.
